title: Pure F.A.
summary: F.A. cards only, plus the two U.A. cards that are always treated as F.A. cards, with staples and an automatic Extra Deck. F.A. racers are Machines with 0 base ATK that gain 300 ATK per Level, and they gain a Level each time an F.A. Spell/Trap or effect is activated. At Level 7 or higher they unlock extra effects. The F.A. Field Spells raise every F.A. monster's Level by 2, and each one searches any F.A. card when destroyed by a card effect, which F.A. Test Run does on purpose. F.A. Auto Navigator searches a Field Spell and lowers a racer's Level to become a matching Tuner. U.A. Hyper Stadium is a Field Spell that searches an F.A. monster and grants an extra F.A. Normal Summon. F.A. Dark Dragster comes out next to a Level 7 racer and destroys cards by spending Levels, and F.A. Dawn Dragster negates Spells and Traps the same way.
main: F.A. Auto Navigator
Tuner: searches an F.A. Field Spell; takes a racer's extra Levels as its own.
F.A. Hang On Mach
Racer: unaffected by smaller monsters; banishes what goes to their GY at Level 7.
F.A. Sonic Meister
Racer: survives smaller attackers; attacks twice at Level 7.
F.A. Whip Crosser
Racer: taxes small monsters' effects; stops hand costs at Level 7.
F.A. Turbo Charger
Level 6 racer: draws attacks and targeting; no responses in battle at Level 7.
F.A. Dark Dragster
Summons itself next to a Level 7 racer; spends Levels to destroy a card.
U.A. Hyper Stadium
Field Spell treated as F.A.: searches an F.A. monster; grants an extra Normal Summon.
F.A. City Grand Prix
Field Spell: +2 Levels in Main and Battle Phase; stops targeting; searches when destroyed.
F.A. Circuit Grand Prix
Field Spell: +2 Levels in battle; draws on kills; searches when destroyed.
F.A. Off-Road Grand Prix
Field Spell: +2 Levels in the Main Phase; searches when destroyed.
F.A. Test Run
Destroys a card, often your own Field Spell; from the GY, trades your card for a racer from the Deck.
F.A. Downforce
Raises a racer by 2 Levels, twice per copy.
F.A. Pit Stop
Lowers a racer to draw; revives one from the GY.
U.A. Locker Room
Quick-Play treated as F.A.: recovers a racer; shuffles racers back to draw.
F.A. Overheat
Summons a racer from the hand when only they have monsters; reactivates a Field Spell.
F.A. Dead Heat
Summons a racer from the Deck on a direct attack.
extra: Level 7 Synchro: spends 2 Levels to negate a Spell/Trap.
Level 9 Synchro: indestructible at Level 11; revives racers at 13.
Link-2: negates a monster effect with Athlete Counters.
